ownerIntake.businessType: SaaS platform, $6M ARR, 40% growth, but customer support costs rising 60% YoY
ownerIntake.stage: Trap: Scaling success narrative ('we're growing 40%!') masks inefficiency (support costs rising 60% = support cost per customer rising). Leadership celebrating growth without recognizing operational leverage gap.
ownerIntake.ownerGoal: Must diagnose: is support cost rise temporary (new feature adoption) or structural (product-market fit issue)?
